items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Exact decision: approve only the six isolated task-routing metadata repairs, subject to installed-owner validation and rollback to prior metadata; block public launch, production deployment, monetization expansion, analytics activation, credential/configuration changes, dependency additions, and security-sensitive exposure. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or findings; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; security site facts are unknown across 61 managed sites; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance reports 36 passes, 19 fails, and 6 unknowns. No credential exposure or exploit is evidenced, but missing telemetry is not clearance. Severity: high for production admission; low for metadata-only routing repairs.

Routing repairs must remain ownership-metadata-only, preserve task text and scope, require validation that the target role is installed, and include rollback to the prior metadata value. They do not clear launch, release, access, secrets, isolation, TLS, dependency, monitoring, incident, or disclosure gates.
